title: RepoAssure Product Completion Gap Audit Refresh v0.7
objective: Reassess remaining product gaps after closing the local-only multi-repo workspace repair summary slice by comparing PLAN, SPEC, PRD, code, tests, package boundaries, manual gates, external-input state, and deferred work, then select at most one bounded next Goal without changing runtime behavior or expanding product entrypoints.
acceptance: Reconcile implemented product surfaces against PLAN, SPEC, PRD, code, tests, package evidence, and the completed workspace repair summary audit.
Classify remaining work as implemented, blocked or manual-gated, external-input-gated, deferred, or safe auto-executable.
Preserve the existing detector-decision block, design-system deferral, release gates, no-write boundary, and validation-only MCP boundary.

Do not reinterpret local-only summary completion as authorization for installed CLI or MCP productization, command execution, patch application, target repository writes, publication, deployment, or hosted availability.
Select at most one acceptance-sized next Codex Goal when supported by evidence, or record that maintainer input is required.
Cascade the refreshed state through canonical docs, testing and acceptance evidence, logs, and Autopilot state.
